title: BANAN'EM UP!
description:
BANAN'EM UP

BANAN'EM UP! is a tiny challenging arcade shoot’em up where you shoot down quirky aliens to save your planet. Evade bullets, shoot enemies, get upgrades, survive for challenging waves to defeat the final boss, "The MONKE". Die, learn, repeat: get stronger, be powerful!

FEATURES

👾20 handcrafted and hard levels

⏰20 mins of playtime

🚀6 unique upgrades!

🕹️Perfect 128x128 arcade look and feel powered by Pico8

Hi, it's SkyBrave! I make short games every month! Join my Discord channel to stay connected!

This game made thanks to the LazyDevs Academy, I followed his shmup tutorial to add new features and levels to the game. Please support him, he's amazing!
